title: AWR Capacity - CPU and workload series
description: Host CPU against the 80 % saturation line, DB CPU per container with level shifts, and sessions / processes / size / redo against their limits, each with its forecast.

panels.title: Host CPU busy %: observed, p95 forecast (dashed), anomalies (red)
panels.description: Daily host busy % (average and busy-hour p95) from OSSTAT. Right of today: the REGR forecast of p95 with its band. Red dashed line: the 80 % saturation line. Red dots: days any baseline mode flagged (trailing, same weekday, or an hour of the day against its hour of the week); red markers: each flagged day or hour, with its message on hover.

panels.title: DB CPU % of host per container (red region = level shift window)
panels.description: Time-model DB CPU as a share of host CPU, per container. A red region marks a level shift: it starts where the recent window starts and ends on the day the shift was observed. A red marker is a day or hour the anomaly layer flagged.

panels.title: Host CPU busy % per hour, last 14 days: usual for that hour (dashed), hour-of-week anomalies (red)
panels.description: Host busy % per AWR hour bucket (the bucket's end hour). The dashed line is the median of the same weekday and hour over the last weeks; a red dot is an hour the HOUR_OF_WEEK baseline flagged.

panels.title: CPU trend (latest fit per metric, soonest saturation first)
panels.description: Linear fit per CPU metric; days until it crosses the 80 % line.

panels.title: Workload series (latest fit, soonest limit first)
